capabilities: open today's Rosary note from a sidebar icon or hotkey
select the mystery set by weekday and liturgical season
configure the folder and mystery note titles used
choose between Luminous and Joyful mysteries on Thursdays
extras: README states Claude helped build the plugin and offers downloadable starter notes with scripture passages and reflection blanks; it warns that setting the Rosary path can be finicky.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a specific prayer note that changes with the day of the week or liturgical calendar.
summary: Daily Rosary opener that opens the note for today's mysteries, chosen by weekday and liturgical season.
